name: image_flux3_klein_base_edit_2img
description: FLUX 3 Image Klein Base image edit with two reference images: the undistilled 5.6B checkpoint at 50 euler/simple steps, cfg 3.5 (the official template uses cfg 1; 3.5 is BFL's recommendation for this checkpoint), empty negative. Prefer the image_flux3_klein_distilled_edit_* templates for everyday edits. Pipeline mirrors ComfyUI's official image_flux3_klein_image_edit template: references are resized to about 1 MP and attached to both conditionings by ReferenceMultiLatent, whose empty latent (sized to image 1) is what gets sampled, so the output follows image 1's aspect ratio and there are no aspect_ratio presets. The official Qwen3.5 9B prompt upsampler sees the references and rewrites the instruction (prompt_upsampling). Refer to references as <ref_image_0> and <ref_image_1>. The official template's bounding-box branch and ImageCompare preview are left out. Fits a 16 GB GPU (models load one at a time). ~17.7 GB of model downloads; run check_requirements / download_models first. Shares the text encoder, upsampler and VAE with every other image_flux3_klein_* template. Weights are gated on Hugging Face under the FLUX Kommunity License (free commercial use only below US$5M annual revenue): accept the license at huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy and set HF_TOKEN before download_models. Needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer.

prompt.description: Edit / composition instruction. Refer to the inputs as <ref_image_0> and <ref_image_1>, and describe the whole finished image (e.g. 'The man from <ref_image_0> wearing the hat from <ref_image_1>, same pose and background as <ref_image_0>').

image1.description: Image to edit (<ref_image_0>). Its aspect ratio sets the output's.

prompt_upsampling.description: Run the edit instruction (with the reference images) through the official Qwen3.5 9B FLUX 3 prompt upsampler before encoding (default 'on', as BFL recommends: short prompts give generic results without it). 'off' encodes your text verbatim and skips loading the 6.7 GB upsampler, which saves time when you already wrote a full, detailed scene caption.

reference_megapixels.description: Size each reference is resized to before encoding, aspect preserved (float 0.01-16, default 1.0 = about 1024x1024). Also sets the output size, which follows image 1. Larger keeps more detail at the cost of time and VRAM; stay at or below 2.0 on a 16 GB GPU.

steps.description: Sampler steps (default 50, as in the official template and BFL's model card). Fewer steps trade detail for speed.

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance (default 3.5, BFL's recommendation for the undistilled base; the official edit template runs this checkpoint at cfg 1, which is faster but flatter).

seed.description: Sampler seed, for reproducing an earlier generation. Omit it and a fresh random seed is used on every submission.
